answer: Audits are recorded in beacon, queued in vertex, and ripple publishes the wait time. A farm of 299 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 35 identities per epoch. A farm of 4777 identities would post 3508 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
